hooks.text: 一边驾驶飞船躲避轰击，一边管理自动炮塔清理无尽小行星带
hooks.excerpt: Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 采掘小行星、回收资源并升级飞船，形成持续递增的采矿火力循环
hooks.excerpt: Void Miner is a incremental roguelite bullet hell that is about mining asteroids, collecting resources and upgrading your ship to blast through waves of asteroid belts.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从简易飞船起步探索升级树，最终把整片小行星带变成清场目标
hooks.excerpt: Start with a simple ship, picking off as many asteroids as you can. Explore the upgrade tree. Lay waste to the entire asteroid belt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
